mapper.update: UPDATE public.health_examination_participant_services s SET row_version=s.row_version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,is_performed=v.performed,service_request_id=v.request_id,recorded_by=v.actor,recorded_at=v.recorded_at FROM (VALUES (CAST(#{s.id} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.batchId} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.batchParticipantId} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.batchServiceId} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.isPerformed} AS boolean), CAST(#{s.serviceRequestId} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.recordedBy} AS uuid),CAST(#{s.recordedAt} AS timestamptz),CAST(#{s.rowVersion} AS bigint)) ) AS v(id,batch_id,participant_id,service_id,performed,request_id,actor,recorded_at,version) WHERE s.id=v.id AND s.batch_id=v.batch_id AND s.batch_participant_id=v.participant_id AND s.batch_service_id=v.service_id AND s.row_version=v.version
